entity.description: Records the manager's or the owner's approval of a POC's open gate. Called by the app's Approve button (role manager) and by the Slack listener (role owner). When both approvals are in, the gate passes and the POC moves to the next phase; then it tells the owner in Slack and, for the Plan gate of a POC with a build run, starts the build.
